procedures.title: Confined Space Entry Procedure
steps: 1. Identify confined space classification (permit-required or non-permit-required)
2. Obtain valid Confined Space Entry Permit
3. Isolate all energy sources (LOTO if applicable)
4. Purge and ventilate the space
5. Test atmosphere: O2 19.5–23.5%, LEL <10%, toxic gases <PEL
6. Assign qualified attendant outside the space at all times
7. Establish rescue plan and have rescue equipment ready
8. Enter only after all permit conditions are satisfied
9. Monitor atmosphere continuously during entry
10. Exit and cancel permit on completion or if conditions change

procedures.title: Working at Height Procedure
steps: 1. Complete Job Safety Analysis (JSA) for height work
2. Obtain working at height permit if required
3. Inspect all equipment: harness, lanyards, anchor points, scaffolding
4. Establish 100% tie-off rule — no movement without connection
5. Implement exclusion zone below work area
6. Check weather conditions — suspend work in high winds or rain
7. Ensure rescue plan is in place for fall arrest
8. Do not lean over edges or climb outside designated access points

procedures.title: Crane and Rigging Safety Procedure
steps: 1. Obtain Lifting Permit for all critical lifts
2. Calculate load weight and verify rigging capacity
3. Verify safety factor: minimum 5.0 for critical lifts
4. Inspect all lifting gear — slings, shackles, hooks
5. Establish exclusion zone — no persons under suspended load
6. Appoint qualified Rigger and Crane Operator
7. Conduct pre-lift meeting with all personnel
8. Verify wind speed is within crane operational limits
9. Lift proceeds only after all permit conditions satisfied
